title: Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #06 (세로 띠·물결 | 이레즈미+흑요암금+목재+보태니컬)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 20% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 40% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 67% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, autumn maple storm formations in VIVID CRIMSON and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries rich reddish mahogany wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep red-brown grain with VIVID copper highlight streaks. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries living orchid blooms growing directly from her own skin, every stem rooted in her living skin and every petal standing in three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, BLAZING VIOLET blossoms, VIVID GOLD leaves and tendrils. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
